sentences.text: IPMA has issued an orange warning for rough sea in the Lisboa district from 2026-11-19 06:00 to 2026-11-19 12:00 local time.
A yellow warning for rough sea in the Lisboa district follows, from 2026-11-19 12:00 to 2026-11-20 09:00 local time.
For Lisboa today, 2026-11-19, IPMA forecasts a minimum of 12.8 °C and a maximum of 18.5 °C, with a 2% chance of rain and moderate wind from W.
For Lisboa tomorrow, 2026-11-20, IPMA forecasts a minimum of 12.4 °C and a maximum of 17.7 °C, with a 43% chance of rain and moderate wind from S.
The IPMA sea forecast for the Lisboa coast on 2026-11-20 gives waves of 2.1 to 3.5 metres from NW and a sea temperature of 17.5 to 17.6 °C.
The Lisbon feed links to 'Web Summit opens in Lisbon with humanoid robots as speakers and a focus on physical AI', a story published by portugalglobal.pt.
The Lisbon feed also links to 'Lisbon drone maker Beyond Vision raises over 28 million euros to speed up AI and swarm technology', a story published by vestbee.com.
A further link is to 'University of Lisbon builds two AI data centres', a story published by portugalglobal.pt.
